name: tmuxy
description: A tmux terminal wrapper - available as Tauri app or web server

scripts.build: npm run build -w tmuxy-ui && cargo build --release -p tmuxy-server && cd packages/tmuxy-tauri-app && tauri build
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build -p tmuxy-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --no-default-features && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir packages/tmuxy-wasm/pkg --out-name tmuxy_wasm target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/tmuxy_wasm.wasm
scripts.stop: pm2 stop tmuxy-dev 2>/dev/null; pm2 stop tmuxy-prod 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.demo: pm2 stop tmuxy-dev 2>/dev/null; bash bin/kill-port 9000; npm run build -w tmuxy-ui && npm run dev -w tmuxy-demo -- --port 9003 --hostname 0.0.0.0
scripts.lint: eslint tests/ && npm run lint -w tmuxy-ui
scripts.check:fast: npm run check:policy && npm run preflight && npm run lint && (cd packages/tmuxy-ui && npx tsc --noEmit) && npm test -- --run
scripts.check:full: npm run check:policy && npm run preflight:full && npm run check:fast && npm run test:cli && TERM=xterm-256color cargo test --workspace
